{{Quote|Vader's set up a special assassination unit of former Republic commandos and ARCs within the Five-oh-first solely to hunt Jedi, deserters and sympathizers.|[[Mereel Skirata]]|<ref name="ImpCom501" />}}
The '''Imperial Commando Special Unit''' was a [[Special forces/Legends|special forces]] [[Division/Legends|division]] of elite operatives of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. First formed from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army's]] [[Special Operations Brigade/Legends|Special Operations Brigade]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. With roughly a thousand [[Commando/Legends|commandos]] left by the end of the conflict, the remaining [[Squad/Legends|squads]] were reorganized as a special [[Division/Legends|division]] within the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]], the personal [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] unit that served directly under the command of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].

During the early [[Imperial Era/Legends|period]] of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]], the Imperial commandos were often tasked with assignments that involved hunting down and [[Assassin/Legends|assassinating]] the enemies of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], ranging from fugitive [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to [[Null-class Advanced Recon Commando|clone renegades]] and deserters. The unit was first commanded by the [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]], [[Sa Cuis]], but was later replaced by [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Roly Melusar]] after his death. The first Imperial commandos included three of the four members of [[Delta Squad/Legends|Delta Squad]]: [[Boss (clone commando)/Legends|Boss]] under the number IC-1138, [[RC-1140/Legends|Fixer]] under the number IC-1140 and [[Scorch/Legends|Scorch]] under the number IC-1262; [[Sev/Legends|Sev]] had disappeared in the line of duty. The commandos left over from [[Omega Squad]] and [[Galaar Squad]] were merged into [[Squad 40]].

==History==
{{Quote|Your former special forces comrades are adept at causing death and chaos. So you are the ones best placed to locate and neutralize them. I expect no quarter given to them. They were your brothers once, but they are now traitors, an insult to all of you and your sacrifices. You are now the Imperial Commando Special Unit. Do ''not'' disappoint me.|Darth Vader, to the Imperial commandos|<ref name="ImpCom501" />}}
The [[New Order/Legends|New Order's]] first [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial]] [[Commando/Legends|commandos]] were the [[Clone commando/Legends|Republic commandos]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army's]] [[Special Operations Brigade/Legends|Special Operations Brigade]].<ref name="Order66">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref> With the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] immediately followed by the [[Declaration of a New Order|rise]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> the remaining commandos were transferred to the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]], an elite [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] [[Legion/Legends|unit]] under the command of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].<ref name="Order66" /> Known collectively as the Imperial Commando Special Unit, the new organization remained comprised of [[DNA/Legends|genetically]]-[[Cloning/Legends|identical]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]], bred from the [[Jango Fett/Legends|same]] [[Clone template/Legends|clone line]]<ref name="ImpCom501" /> that produced the Republic [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]].<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref> Nearly everything else about the commandos&mdash;their [[Armor/Legends|armor]], designations and even their [[Squad/Legends|squads]]&mdash;were altered to reflect the Empire's policy of [[Imperialization/Legends|Imperialization]].<ref name="Order66" />

[[File:501st_Commandos.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Imperial commandos of the 501st Legion]]
The Imperial commando ranks did not reflect the full strength that the former Special Operations Brigade started with at the beginning of the Clone Wars. In addition to several confirmed deserters, attrition due to three [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of [[civil war]] inflicted heavy [[Death/Legends|casualties]] on them, leaving the Empire to inherit roughly a thousand clone commandos by the end of the conflict.<ref name="ImpCom501" /> In addition to the millions of new [[Clone stormtrooper|clone soldiers]] that swelled the ranks of the [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]],<ref name="Order66" /> [[Arkanian Microtechnologies]] produced [[Spaarti cloning cylinder|Spaarti]]-engineered clones for the purpose of replenishing the commando ranks.<ref name="ImpCom501" /> The original commandos that were bred via [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] techniques<ref name="Order66" /> were secretly agitated by the introduction of clones from the [[Arkanian/Legends|Arkanian]] batch of [[Centax-2/Legends|Centax-2]],<ref name="ImpCom501" /> whom they regarded as subpar [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] with inferior [[Flash pumping|training]].<ref name="EGtW:AC7">{{SW|url=news/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-7-the-grand-army-of-the-republic|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 7 &mdash; The Grand Army of the Republic}}</ref><ref name="Order66" /> Though the former Republic commandos composed the vast majority of the Imperial Commando Special Unit, a number of [[Alpha-class Advanced Recon Commando|''Alpha''-class ARC troopers]] were also recruited into the 501st ranks to train new generations of the Empire's elite [[Shock trooper/Legends|shock troopers]].<ref name="ImpCom501" />

In the days that followed [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] rise to absolute power, the commandos replaced their old [[Katarn-class commando armor/Legends|''Katarn''-class armor]] for a new suit of armor,<ref name="Order66" /> devoid of unit markings and personal customizations<ref name="ImpCom501" /> in accordance with the New Order's emphasis on uniformity and obedience.<ref name="EG Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> Squads that had suffered one or more losses were either given new replacements or combined with other squads. The former [[Delta Squad/Legends|Delta Squad's]] final member, [[Sev/Legends|Sev]], was replaced by a new commando; the remaining members of [[Galaar Squad]] and [[Omega Squad]] were amalgamated to form [[Squad 40]]. However, their identification numbers, apart from the ''IC'' prefix, remained the same. In addition to retaining the same designations, the commandos were permitted to keep the [[DC-17m Interchangeable Weapon System/Legends|DC-17 rifle]] for a time, mostly because it was the primary weapon that they were accustomed with.<ref name="ImpCom501" />

Though overall command of the unit fell to [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Vader, Imperial commando operations were more closely monitored by a subordinate of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]]. Their first [[Commander/Legends|commander]] was the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Sa Cuis]],<ref name="ImpCom501" /> a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] known as an [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]].<ref name="IHI">{{StoryCite|story=In His Image|book=Vader: The Ultimate Guide}}</ref> After Cuis's death, leadership of the Imperial commandos reverted to an [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]] named [[Roly Melusar]].<ref name="ImpCom501" />
